page.overview:
What is Enfeil?

Enfeil was a planet in the Known Universe. It was conquered by the Ninth Legion of Muad'dib's Jihad, led by the Bashar Farok, in the Battle of Enfeil.

The planet had mountains, seas and trees. Farok immersed himself in one of its seas, the water of which was bitter and made him ill. The planet had a sun.
